gaps.s: Farming for the farmer's own family is called ___ farming.
Farming for sale is called ___ farming.
Car making belongs to the ___ sector.
A decline in manufacturing in a place is called ___.
Extreme food shortage with many deaths is a ___.
Tourism where profits go abroad shows ___.
Tourism that protects the environment is ___ tourism.
Farming with high inputs on a small area is ___ farming.

short.q: Explain two human factors that affect farming.
short.model: Access to markets and transport lets farmers sell produce, so more commercial farming occurs near cities. Capital allows purchase of machinery and fertiliser, raising yields.

short.q: Explain how conflict can cause food shortage.
short.model: Fighting forces farmers to leave their land and destroys crops and roads. Food cannot be grown or moved, and prices rise.

short.q: Explain why an electronics factory might locate in China's Pearl River Delta.
short.model: There is a large, cheap labour force, and ports allow cheap export. The government offers tax incentives and the area has good infrastructure.

short.q: Describe two environmental costs of tourism.
short.model: Footpaths erode and litter builds up. Coral reefs and habitats can be damaged by divers, boats and development.

short.q: Explain one way to increase food supply in a low-income country.
short.model: Irrigation brings water to dry areas, so crops can grow and several harvests can be taken a year, raising total production.
